neighbours.label: Google search ranking updates and penalties, especially Penguin and Panda.
fire: The site lost traffic after the Google Penguin update penalized its links.
Google Panda lowered the ranking of pages with copied articles.
The webmaster blamed a Google algorithm change for the sudden drop in rankings.
A new Google search penalty removed our pages from the top results.
The search engine updated its ranking algorithm and demoted thin content.
Our backlinks triggered a ranking penalty after the latest search update.
Google Penguin and Panda updates changed which websites appeared first.
The consultant investigated whether Google's recent algorithm update had penalized the store.
quiet: The site tracked traffic with the Google Analytics dashboard and its charts.
Google Trends displayed the popularity of queries about newspaper articles.
The webmaster used a Google search report to inspect the current rankings.
A new Google search tutorial explained how to inspect the top results.
The search engine documented its ranking interface and displayed article previews.
Our backlinks appeared in a ranking report after the latest traffic review.
The penguin and panda exhibits changed which zoo buildings visitors saw first.
The consultant investigated whether Google's recent analytics report had counted the store's visitors.

notes: Tests update/penalty context, including two examples without the Google name. A literal zoo use checks the animal words without the search context. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory sentences are disjoint from this preregistered test.
